description: This file contains the implementation of the EcuQuery interface, representing a query to an ECU (Engine Control Unit). It provides methods to get ECU address data, handle responses, and override standard object methods.

classes.name: EcuQueryImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the EcuQuery interface, encapsulating data and behaviors for querying an ECU.

methods.name: EcuQueryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with ECU data and prepares serialization info.

methods.name: getLoggerData
methods.description: Returns the ECU data associated with this query.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the addresses associated with the ECU.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array representing the ECU address.

methods.name: getHex
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string representation of the address bytes.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the latest response value from the ECU.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response value by converting a byte array via the ECU's convertor.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another object is equal to this EcuQueryImpl based on the hex address.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the hex address.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, prefixed with '0x'.
